gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap is a common diagnostic, not a storage intervention in this group; callback intervals do not prove pure CPU pause cost or recovery-policy causation.

common_capacity_observation.purpose: Retain r02 observation unchanged. At cap224 there may be no recovery opportunity/snapshot; that is a valid baseline outcome.
common_capacity_observation.boundary: After the unchanged action callback and before the native allocator, including the first return-to-native attempt after entry completion or the16-entry bound. Entry completion alone is not a capacity snapshot.
common_capacity_observation.fields: Target plus union(RUNNING,_inflight_prefills), object identity/membership/status/history N/physically-held H/computed C/earlier-inflight I/current-local scheduled Q; actual reserved and free at this same CPU boundary; qualified layout or explicit UNKNOWN.
common_capacity_observation.growth_rule: No growth horizon selected and no capacity-rule intervention. Store raw state so explicit conditional arithmetic can later distinguish target/inflight/running contributions. No scheduler-round-to-token assumption.
common_capacity_observation.source: observe_progress.py over frozen start_gate.py; existing pure progress_capacity.py is CPU arithmetic only and does not control actions.
common_capacity_observation.bounds: One selected target per cell. Native records its one initial boundary; wait_release records up to16 holds and the first return-to-native attempt. Other heads remain native and are not traced by this observer.
common_capacity_observation.cost: Host perf_counter start/end and elapsed for each snapshot are retained. No CUDA synchronization/event/query, lookup, allocation, predicted completion or prospective freeing.
common_capacity_observation.inference_limit: Neither capacity_fit nor sustained-service feasibility follows from a request completion. No future states or neighboring trace snapshots are used. Raw snapshots/shadow arithmetic do not establish an alternative policy performance result.

scope: One exploratory strong-simple-configuration screening group on the existing workload/current GPU. No optimum, method, independent confirmation or cross-run same-state claim.
selection: Runtime cap224 is one prespecified midpoint between previously measured192(low-pressure) and256(high-pressure). No search over adjacent caps.
primary_readout: All-arrival per-request maximum generation gap mean/P99/max and distribution; TTFT/completion/throughput/drain and workload/observation costs are mandatory tradeoffs. Old joint SLO unchanged and diagnostic, not an application success criterion.
stop_rule: Exactly four native cells if healthy. Zero recovery/B intervention does not stop the group. Nonzero/missing B action evidence or actual cap mismatch aborts. Any failed/timeout cell retained, no automatic retry or extra configurations.

stage_budget.basis: r02 observed cell wall244–252s; initialization/warmup included. Cleanup and original boundary checks outside child budget still retain lock until safe release. No fee/remaining-credit telemetry.

research_question: Can a moderately conservative static runtime cap remove recovery-associated streaming stalls, and what externally measured TTFT/flow/throughput cost does that impose?
decision: If cap224 covers the main useful tradeoff, stop current-domain single-event gating investment. If recovery remains or improvement transfers cost to TTFT/efficiency, characterize the remaining tradeoff before choosing further B action. Mixed results remain uncertain; no automatic repeat or cap scan.
